title: Sarpedon recovers beneath Zeus’ tree
intro: Odysseus' attack draws Hector forward. Sarpedon pleads for protection, then revives after the spear is removed.

notes.text: προτέρω, farther forward; ἐρίγδουπος, loud-thundering: gen sg with Διός.
διώκω pres opt; αἱρέω 2aor mid opt, both 3sg. Indirect deliberation after μερμήριξε (671): whether to pursue Sarpedon or kill more Lycians.
ἀπό separated from the verb; “take away the life.” τῶν πλεόνων Λυκίων: gen pl, “of the greater number of Lycians.”
μεγαλήτωρ, great-hearted: dat sg with Odysseus. μόρσιμος, fated; impersonal “it was not allotted”; ἦεν = ἦν.
ἴφθιμος, mighty. ἀποκτείνω, kill: epic root aor act inf -μεν, stem κτα-.
τώ, therefore. πληθύς, mass / multitude: acc sg. τρέπω, turn: unaugmented 3sg 2aor; Athena redirects his θυμός, intent.
αἱρέω, take / slay: 3sg 2aor; followed by seven victims' names through 678.
κτείνω, unaugmented 3sg aor; unreal past: “would have killed … if Hector had not noticed.” πλέονας = πλείονας, more.
ὀξύ adv., keenly / quickly; κορυθαίολος, flashing-helmed (κόρυς + αἰόλος).
κορύσσω, arm: perf mid/pass ptc; αἶθοψ, gleaming: dat sg; “armed in gleaming bronze.”
δεῖμα, terror. χαίρω: unaugmented 3sg aor pass form, “rejoiced”; + dat οἱ προσιόντι, “at his approach.”
Piteous / plaintive; with ἔπος, word / speech.
ἐάω: 2sg aor subj, prohibition. ἕλωρ, prey / spoil (neut), predicate to με; κεῖμαι pres inf. “Do not leave me lying as prey for the Greeks.”
ἐπαμύνω, come to someone's defence: 2sg aor imperative.
λείπω, leave: 3sg 2aor opt, wish / resigned concession; αἰών, life: “then let life leave me.”
μέλλω: 1sg impf, “I was destined / was going to”; εὐφραίνω, gladden: uncontracted fut act inf. Negated: he expects no homecoming.
νοστέω, return home: aor ptc nom sg. οἶκον δέ = οἶκονδε, homeward (-δε directional).
ἄλοχος, wife; νήπιος, infant / very young, with υἱόν.
παραΐσσω, dart past: 3sg aor. λελίημαι, be eager / strain: perf mid ptc nom sg; a dictionary headword in its own right.
Purpose clause, two 3sg aor mid optatives: ὠθέω, push back; αἱρέω, take [life]. πολέων = πολλῶν.
ἵζω, seat: 3pl aor act; companions set Sarpedon down.
περικαλλής, very beautiful: uncontracted dat sg; φηγός, oak (fem), sacred to Zeus here.
μείλινος, ash-wood. ὠθέω, push: 3sg aor; θύραζε, out (literally out of doors); “pushed the spear out.”
ἴφθιμος, strong / valiant; ἦεν = ἦν.
λείπω, unaugmented 3sg 2aor; “his life-breath left him.” A faint here: he revives immediately.
χέω, pour / spread: 3sg plup mid/pass, κέχυτο; ἀχλύς, mist / darkness, subject.
“Breathed again / revived”; 3sg aor pass form of ἄμπνυτο / ἀμπνύω, related to ἀναπνέω.
πνοιή, breeze / breath; Βορέας, north wind: gen sg. ἐπιπνέω, blow upon: pres ptc nom fem sg.
ζωγρέω, restore to life: unaugmented 3sg impf. κεκαφηώς, gasping / exhausted: perf act ptc acc masc sg with θυμόν; rare form, no ordinary present in Homer.
χαλκοκορυστής, bronze-armoured warrior: dat sg with Hector; ὑπό + dat, under pressure from.
προτρέπομαι, turn to flight / be driven headlong: 3pl impf; negated. The second οὔτε and continuing retreat follow next page.
